game: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One
scope: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One (2019), English IELLO core and original four hero/action components, with official IELLO/Restoration August11,2025 Excalibur erratum. Standard duel; teams, other sets, Adventures excluded. Q64 explicitly asks the historical original interpretation, retained unchanged; current play follows2025 rule and is directly asked Q66.

questions.question: How is a duel set up: cards and health, who places where and in what order, legal sidekick spaces including a multizone hero space, when is Alice’s initial size chosen, and who takes the first turn?
What actions must you take on a turn, may you repeat or skip an action, and when and how do you enforce the 7-card hand limit if you temporarily hold 9?

During an ordinary maneuver, in what order do drawing and movement occur, which fighters may move how far, and can you pass through friendly or enemy fighters, end on an occupied space, or interleave two fighters’ moves?
How do you BOOST maneuver movement, what happens to the discarded card’s printed effect, who receives the movement increase, and may a defeated sidekick’s unusable card pay for it?
Your empty deck is asked to draw 2 cards by a mandatory effect while your hero and a sidekick survive. Do you reshuffle or decline the draws, and what damage does each fighter take?
For a melee fighter and a ranged fighter, which targets are legal if adjacent across a zone boundary, nonadjacent in the same zone, or in a disconnected part of the same colored zone?

When is an attack action illegal, who must be named as attacker, what cards may each combatant use, may the defender decline a card, and when are the cards revealed? How do versatile cards count for other effects?
Give the full combat resolution order, including simultaneous effect priority, whether effects are optional, other after-combat game effects and played-card destinations.
An attack value 4 meets defense value 4, then a card effect deals 2 damage to the defender. Who won and why? With no defense card against an attack value 4, how much attack damage is dealt?

A sidekick reaches zero during combat but its hero lives; what happens to the token and its played card’s after-combat effect? What changes if instead a hero reaches zero, even if a later healing effect was pending?
How do you play and resolve a scheme, can you use a scheme restricted to a defeated fighter, and who may inspect whose discard pile when?
State Alice’s starting health, movement, attack type, Jabberwock stats, initial-size choice, and the combat bonuses for BIG and SMALL. Do the size bonuses apply to Jabberwock?
State Arthur and Merlin’s starting health, attack types and move value. When and how may Arthur boost an attack using his ability, and what if the opposing card cancels his attack-card effects?
State Medusa’s starting health, move and attack type; her sidekicks’ number, health and attack type; and the timing, optionality, target and amount of her special ability.

State Sinbad and Porter’s health and attack types and normal move value. With 3 Voyage cards already discarded, how far may each move in a maneuver and what is a newly played base-2 Voyage’s combat value before other modifiers? Does the played Voyage count itself yet?
What exactly do Alice’s Eat Me and Drink Me schemes do, in which order, and may she refuse the size change after taking their first benefit?

Jabberwock attacks with Jaws That Bite, Arthur defends with Skirmish, both value 4. Arthur moves Jabberwock away so it has no adjacent fighters. Resolve damage, winner, timing and the Jaws effect. If a friendly fighter alone were adjacent instead, could Alice decline to damage it?
Arthur uses The Holy Grail. At its after-combat timing he has respectively 4, 5, or 0 health. What happens in each case, and can any healing exceed the dial maximum?
What movement exception does Winged Frenzy grant, to which fighters and for how far? What happens afterward if a Harpy has been defeated, where may it return, and may it end on an occupied space?

Sinbad plays Voyage Home with 4 other Voyages in his discard pile. If uncancelled and game continues, what is its value, what returns where after combat, where does Voyage Home itself end, and what is his next unboosted maneuver allowance?
What does Regroup draw after combat if you win versus lose? If it is your defeated sidekick’s played card and the duel continues, does that draw still occur?

Your fighter plays Momentous Shift while in its turn-start space after moving away and back. Is the value 3 or 5? What if it is now in a different space from where it started this turn, including when defending on the opponent’s turn?

After Looking Glass, what choices are available, how many must be different, and can you choose the draw twice or place Alice in her current or an occupied space? If Alice is SMALL, what is the card’s defense value?
What condition enables Snicker-Snack’s after-combat hand effect, who sees the hand, who chooses the discarded card, and where does it go? What happens to that effect if Alice loses combat?

For each of O Frabjous Day!, The Other Side of the Mushroom, I’m Late I’m Late, and Mad as a Hatter, state the after-combat movement (who and maximum distance, if any) and size effect. Can these size changes alter the attack damage already resolved?

Manxome Foe is played with printed value 3 and its during-combat discard reveals a card of combat value 5 and BOOST 2. Which card is discarded from where, what is Manxome Foe’s value before other modifiers, and does that discard count as drawing a card?
Jabberwock uses Claws That Catch against a hero, then in a separate combat against a sidekick. What is its combat value in each case before other modifiers, and does Alice being BIG add to either?

Arthur attacks with Noble Sacrifice, committing a BOOST-2 card through his ability and later discarding a BOOST-3 card through Noble Sacrifice. If uncancelled, what is the attack value and when is each boost chosen? If a defending Feint cancels Noble Sacrifice, which boosts survive and what is the attack value?
Who may play The Lady of the Lake, what named card does it retrieve from which locations to where, when must you shuffle, and what are Excalibur’s user, type and printed attack value?
After an uncancelled The Aid of Morgana, do you draw only if Arthur won? How many cards, at what timing, and who is allowed to play it?
Who can play Divine Intervention, as what combat-card type, and whom does it move how far at which timing? Must that fighter have won?
Who plays Prophecy, what happens to the top four cards, and in what order may cards be returned to the deck? Is this a scheme or an attack?

For Bewilderment, name its legal fighter, card type and printed defense value; state its during-combat effect and optional after-combat placement, including destination occupancy. Does its printed zero automatically make the attacker win?
Who plays Aid the Chosen One, what type/value is it, and what happens after combat on a win versus a loss?

For Restless Spirits, who is the active fighter, where must the chosen space be, which spaces and fighters take how much damage, and how many cards are drawn if zero, one or two opposing fighters are defeated? If the opposing hero is defeated, do you finish the draw?
Who plays Command the Storms, which fighters can it move how far, and when moving an opposing fighter which side’s fighters can it pass through and which block it?
Can Merlin use Swift Strike, which fighter does it move, how far and when, and does it require a combat win?

Medusa attacks using Gaze of Stone (value 2) against an uncancelled defense value 2, then in a separate combat against no defense. Assuming no other modifiers and a surviving target, state attack damage, combat winner and Gaze’s extra damage in each case.
Who plays A Momentary Glance, when does it deal how much damage, what determines its target’s location, and may it target a friendly fighter instead of an opponent?

Who can use Hiss and Slither versus Clutching Claws, what are their card types, and what happens after combat? Must you win, and does either printed effect let you choose the opponent’s discard or make it random?
Who can play The Hounds of Mighty Zeus, what type and value is it, and after combat does it move just the fighting Harpy or all Harpies, for how far? Can Medusa play it herself?
When may Second Shot be BOOSTed, who may use it and what is its type/base value? If you discard a BOOST-2 card, what is the attack value and what happens to the discarded card’s effect?
Can a Harpy use Dash as defense, who moves afterward, what is the maximum movement, and must that Harpy win for the movement to occur if it survives?
Who may use Snipe and in which combat roles, and what does it do after combat on a loss as well as a win?
Who may use Toil and Danger and in which combat roles, and what does it move how far at what timing? Does Sinbad’s Voyage-count maneuver bonus increase that card’s printed movement?
Who may play Riches Beyond Compare, what action does it use, and what is its mandatory effect? With 8 cards after resolving it midturn, must you immediately discard?

Who may use By Fortune and Fate, what type/value is it, and what does it do after combat? If Porter is defeated but Sinbad lives, may you initiate it as an attack, and may the unusable card still BOOST?
Compare Commanding Impact and Exploit: allowed users, combat type/value, and their after-combat effects. Do their draws require winning?
For Leap Away, what type/value and permitted users does it have, and what happens after a win versus a loss? Which fighter can be moved how far, and do normal blockers apply if you move an opponent?
After Voyage to the Island That Was a Whale, who recovers how much health, is a combat win required, and what if Sinbad is already at 14 health or has been defeated?
What exactly does Voyage to the Valley of the Giant Snakes do after combat, does it require a win, and does it discard a card from that hand?
What exactly happens after Voyage to the Creature with Eyes Like Coals of Fire, who loses the card, how is it selected, and is a combat win required?
What movement does Voyage to the Cannibals with the Root of Madness allow after combat, who moves, is it optional, and must Sinbad have won?
What happens after Voyage to the City of the Man-Eating Apes if Sinbad lost combat but is alive and the duel continues? Can the 2 damage from this effect change who won the combat?
What happens after Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib, when and for whose hand, and must Sinbad win first?

A required draw of 2 begins with one card left in your deck and all fighters alive. What happens to the first and second draws, does an empty deck alone deal damage before a draw is requested, and does the discard pile get shuffled?
Both combatants play Feint. Which immediately effect resolves first, what happens to the other Feint’s effect, and do the printed combat values vanish?

BIG Alice attacks with O Frabjous Day! against defense 4 with no other effects. What is Alice’s attack value and attack damage, when does size change, and what bonus applies to her next defense while SMALL?

Can Sinbad discard one of the six non-Home Voyage cards to BOOST maneuver movement and thereby put it in the discard pile? How does Voyage Home differ, and is an absent BOOST value simply a printed zero?

BIG Alice attacks with Momentous Shift after starting the turn in another space; defender uses Feint (value 2). What does Feint cancel, does it cancel Alice’s character-card bonus, and what are her attack value and attack damage?

Sinbad begins a maneuver with no Voyages in his discard pile, draws normally, then discards Voyage Home to BOOST before moving. What is the movement allowance for Sinbad and Porter in this maneuver, and does that discard resolve Home’s after-combat retrieval effect?

Group these Alice combat cards by permitted fighter (Alice only, Jabberwock only, or either) and legal role (attack only, defense only, or either): Looking Glass; Snicker-Snack; O Frabjous Day!; The Other Side of the Mushroom; I’m Late, I’m Late; Mad as a Hatter; Jaws That Bite; Claws That Catch; Manxome Foe. Also state the user/role rule for Feint, Regroup, Momentous Shift and Skirmish in original decks that contain them. When Jabberwock is attacked, may Alice-only or attack-only cards be used as its defense?

For The Aid of Morgana, Swift Strike, Gaze of Stone, Winged Frenzy, and all seven original Sinbad Voyage cards, state permitted fighter(s) and whether each is attack only, defense only, versatile, or scheme. Can Merlin defend with Swift Strike or Morgana? Can a Harpy initiate Winged Frenzy or Gaze? Can Porter attack with a Voyage, or Sinbad defend with one?

Under the original Excalibur cancellation interpretation covered by this summary, Arthur attacks with Excalibur and an ability BOOST of 3; the defender plays Feint with defense value 2. Does Excalibur’s lack of printed effects preserve the BOOST, what happens to that BOOST card, and what are the final attack value and attack damage?

SMALL Alice survives an attack of value 4, declines to play any defense card, and no other effects apply. Does she take 3 or 4 attack damage, who wins combat, and why does her SMALL ability change or not change that result?

Under the official August 2025 Excalibur erratum, Arthur attacks with textless Excalibur and an ability BOOST of 3; the defender plays Feint with defense value 2. Does the BOOST still apply, what are the final attack value and attack damage, and does this ruling also preserve the BOOST on Noble Sacrifice if Feint actually cancels that card’s effects?

In an ordinary attack, when must the target be declared relative to choosing combat cards? Who chooses and commits a card first, what faces do the attack card and any defense card show before reveal, may the defender decline a card, and when are the chosen cards revealed? May the attacker wait to see the defense card and then choose a different attack card or target?
